svg.text: Four planes. One trust boundary. No simulated evidence.
Seven modules share one workspace hook. File content is
rendered as text and hex, never HTML.
Browser-only fallback parses a bounded RIFF/AIFF subset
JSON over loopback · Host + Origin enforced · no remote binding
Loopback Host, client, and origin are checked
before routing. Uploads spool to disk without a
size cap. Two methods: GET and POST.
sessions · demo · upload · files/{id}/bytes · compare · download · media
Threads one decoder job at a time. Progress counts
completed process executions. Startup marks stale jobs
session IDs + file IDs only · callers never supply paths
RIFF/WAVE · AIFF/AIFC · FLAC metadata blocks · MP3/ID3v1+v2.
Raw INFO/AIFF/ID3 fields with byte offsets; Mutagen supplements
16 seeded strategies, exact edit offsets, before/after SHA-256,
SQLite WAL index; UUID file names; dirs 0700, files 0600;
Accept/reject matrix, channels, duration, decoded hashes,
JSON is canonical; Markdown and escaped HTML render from it.
fixed argv · one read-only input · no shell · self-test gates execution
ONE DECODER PROCESS TREE AT A TIME
Inside the sandbox; preserves true wait status. Sets
RLIMIT_CPU/AS/FSIZE/NOFILE/CORE before exec. Caps stdout and
Linux: unshare-all + netns, no host home, read-only system dirs,
16 MiB tmpfs. macOS: deny-by-default Seatbelt. Self-test failure
ffmpeg · ffprobe · sndfile-info. Fixed allowlist. ffmpeg emits
decoded-output SHA-256; sndfile-info can exit 0 on rejection.
⚠ Shared kernel, not a disposable VM. The macOS Seatbelt profile is experimental and unverified on Apple Silicon.
